name: mab-bernoulli
description: Classical MAB: 10 Bernoulli instances with 10 arms (means uniform in [0.05, 0.95], gap >= 0.05), 2 runs each. Theoretical defaults.

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: Values of the papers: UCB1 alpha=1, UCB1Tuned alpha=1, UCBV alpha=1, UCBMinV1 alpha=1, KLUCB c=3. They give the theoretical confidence bounds: safe in theory, but they often explore too much in practice. To fit them to this problem, run a grid search (param_grid=True, or "param_grid": true in a config file) or set them, e.g. UCB1(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: Per-action estimates (track "estimates"); action of every step (track "actions"); peak memory (measure_memory=True). The dashboard and the figures cannot show what is not stored; the brackets say how to store it (in a config file: "track": [...] or "measure_memory": true in "experiment").

notices.title: One point every 50 steps
notices.text: Curves keep one point every 50 steps and the last step (log_interval=50). The values at these points are exact. Between two points, the charts draw a straight line: there the curve is interpolated, not measured. log_interval=1 keeps every step (larger files).

notices.title: Parallel runs
notices.text: With n_jobs=4, each process uses one BLAS thread: compare CPU times only between runs with the same n_jobs.
